subject: general
question: The main worker is a person who works for at least ________ days in a year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**183 days**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A main worker is defined as a person who works for at least **183 days** in a year.
 
• This classification is used for statistical and economic analysis to differentiate between main and marginal workers.
 
• Main workers are typically engaged in employment or economic activities for the majority of the year.
 
• This definition helps in understanding the workforce distribution and planning economic policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The classification of workers into main and marginal categories is crucial for census and labor force surveys.
 
• Marginal workers are those who work for less than 183 days in a year.
 
• This distinction aids in the formulation of employment and welfare policies by the government.
 
• Understanding the number of main workers helps in assessing the economic stability and employment rate of a region.
